By means of the bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No. 6 of 2020 at Police Station- Kurara, District- Hamirpur under Sections 498A, 304B, IPC and Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
The applicant is in jail since 30.01.2020.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 26.03.2021.

The following arguments made by Shri Irshad Ahmad, learned counsel assisted by Sri Rahul Dwivedi, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant, which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Shri Paritosh Kumar Malviya, learned AGA-I and Sri Raghav Dwivedi, learned counsel for the informant from the record, entitle the applicant for grant of bail:

sentences.text: 1. The applicant is the husband of the deceased.
The applicant has harmonious relations with his wife.
2. The applicant never harassed the deceased nor did he demand dowry.
3. The applicant is bereaved by the death of his wife.
4. The deceased was depressed as her new born child died shortly after death.
Further the family faced financial stringency due to prolonged and expensive treatment of the deceased.
5. On the fateful day she succumbed to depression and took the extreme step of ending her life.
She committed suicide by hanging.

6. The post mortem report opines that:
(i) The cause of death is asphyxia due to antemortem hanging.
(ii) Hyoid bone was found to be intact.
(iii) Ligature marks were consistent with the hanging.
7. The doctor in his deposition before the trial court has stated that the ante mortem injury was when the body was brought down from hanging position.
8. The applicant did not abet or instigate the deceased to commit suicide.
9. The applicant is a law abiding citizen who cooperated with the police investigations and has joined the trial.
10. The trial is moving at a snail's pace and and shows no sign of early conclusion.
The applicant cannot be faulted for the delay in the trial.
11. Inordinate delay in concluding trial has lead to virtually an indefinite imprisonment of the applicant, without any evidence to implicate him in the offence.
12. The right of the applicant to speedy trial has been violated.
13. The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from this case.
14. The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to cooperate with the court proceedings.
There is no possibility of his influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.

sentences.text: In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant- Akhil @ Munna Singh be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
( ii )
The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

Order Date :- 20.7.2023 Pravin  Akhil @ Munna Singh vs State Of U.P. on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/32645208/
